welcome.text: Yo, welcome to the block! Step up to the chalk line and show the crew what you got.

skully_mode.text: Skully is up! Thirteen chalk boxes — flick that wax bottlecap clean from one to thirteen.

foursquare_mode.text: Four Square on the hot concrete! Dethrone the King of the Block and hold that top square.

stoopball_mode.text: Stoop Ball on the brownstone steps! Catch that sharp corner point and launch a three-sewer home run!

marbles_mode.text: Ring Taw Marbles! Knuckle down at the lag line and knock those glassies clean out the chalk ring.

jacks_mode.text: Sidewalk Jacks! Bounce the pink Spaldeen, scoop your jacks, and catch it before it drops!

box_hit.text: Clean money! Right in the chalk box!

combo_fire.text: Ooh, you're heating up now! Look at that touch!

king_crowned.text: All hail the new King of the Block! Nobody's taking that square today!

sewer_homer.text: Going, going... three sewers deep! That pink Spaldeen is outta here!

double_hit.text: Off the stoop point — two-sewer double down the block!

marble_knockout.text: Clack! Knocked that glassie clean out the ring!

jacks_sweep.text: Quick hands! Scooped 'em clean before the bounce!

car_on_block.text: Yo, hold up — car on the block! Let that seventy-nine Monte Carlo roll through!

rival_turn.text: Watch this flick right here — I own this chalk line!

hydrant_splash.text: Whoo! Johnny pump is wide open — cool off in that hydrant spray!

victory.text: Game, set, and the whole block knows it! You run this street until the streetlights come on!

brooklyn_84.text: Brooklyn, nineteen eighty-four — Bed-Stuy brownstones, boomboxes on the stoop, and hot summer tar.

chicago_79.text: South Side Chicago, seventy-nine — L-train rumbling overhead and the fastest chalk tables in the city.

crenshaw_88.text: Crenshaw Boulevard, eighty-eight — palm trees, golden sunset, and lowriders cruising slow.

pueblo_86.text: Pueblo, Colorado, eighty-six — Bessemer steel-mill pride and high-sunshine neighborhood courts.

intro_block.text: Before smartphones, the whole block was our stadium! Grab a wax bottlecap or a pink Spaldeen and step onto the street!

hood_brooklyn.text: Brooklyn, nineteen eighty-four — Bed-Stuy brownstones, boomboxes on the stoop, and hot summer tar.

hood_chicago.text: South Side Chicago, seventy-nine — L-train rumbling overhead and the fastest chalk tables in the city.

hood_la.text: Crenshaw Boulevard, eighty-eight — palm trees, golden sunset, and lowriders cruising slow.

hood_pueblo.text: Pueblo, Colorado, eighty-six — Bessemer steel-mill pride and high-sunshine neighborhood courts.

mode_skully.text: Skully on the hot asphalt! Drag back that penny-weighted wax cap and flick it clean—one through thirteen!

mode_foursquare.text: Four Square on the hot concrete! Dethrone the King of the Block and hold that top square.

mode_stoopball.text: Stoop Ball on the brownstone steps! Catch that sharp corner point and launch a three-sewer home run!

mode_marbles.text: Ring Taw Marbles! Knuckle down at the lag line and knock those glassies clean out the chalk ring.

mode_jacks.text: Sidewalk Jacks! Bounce the pink Spaldeen, scoop your jacks, and catch it before it drops!

skully_hit.text: Ooh, clean wax flick! Right in the chalk box! Take your bonus turn!

skully_bump.text: Bumped you clean out the box! That chalk line is mine now!

skully_killer.text: Killer unlocked! You ran one through thirteen — now hunt the rivals down!

skully_skull.text: Uh-oh! Trapped in the skull pit! Needs three clean shots to break out!

skully_win.text: King of the Skully board! You cleared the whole block!

fs_king.text: All hail the new King of the Block! Nobody's taking that top square today!

fs_ace.text: Cross-court laser! Put spin on that pink Spaldeen!

fs_out.text: Double bounce in your square! Step back to Jack and work your way up!

stoop_single.text: Clean liner off the stoop — one-sewer single!

stoop_double.text: Sharp off the brownstone edge — two-sewer double down the block!

stoop_triple.text: Rattled off the iron railing! Three-bagger past the hydrant!

stoop_homer.text: Going, going... three sewers deep! That pink Spaldeen is outta here!

stoop_out.text: Pop-up caught on the stoop steps! Side retired!

marbles_knock.text: Clack! Glass on glass! Knocked that mib clean out the dirt ring—shoot again!

marbles_clear.text: Seven marbles in your pouch! You just cleaned out the whole circle—Ringer Champion!

marbles_miss.text: Rolled right through the dust—hand over the turn!

jacks_fumble.text: Ooh, scatter foul! Missed the catch before the second bounce!

jacks_win.text: Fivesies cleared! Fastest hands on the brownstone stoop—you run the block!
